import pixeltable as pxt

# Get the films table
tbl = pxt.get_table('films')

# Filter rows where year > 1990, select title and revenue columns, then materialize
results = tbl.where(tbl['year'] > 1990).select(tbl['title'], tbl['revenue']).collect()
